{{Top}}
The ancient [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] title, '''Defender of the Home Tree''' was bestowed upon one who long protected the [[Wookiee/Legends|People of the Trees]]. These natives protected the Defender with their lives as the Defender did theirs.

In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the term was used to describe [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who, as [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Watchman]] of the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], assisted in many negotiations with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]].
